name: soyhenry.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.soyhenry.com scores 75 out of 100 (C). 8 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 40 pass. Fix first: 2 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /webfullstack, /carrera-data-science. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /webfullstack, /carrera-data-science, for example .B5W-lW_hero-play-button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw TikTok Pixel (4 requests), LinkedIn Insight (3 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Google Analytics (4 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), X Ads (2 requests), and cookies…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 37 elements on /, /webfullstack, /carrera-data-science, for example div:nth-child(4) > button > ._2dsva_vertical.PmVQAa_t-vc-container._04m_ga_container > .PmVQAa_t-vc-info-container > .Pm and div:nth-child(4) > button >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, for example ._40jaHq_he-item:nth-child(4) > ._40jaHq_he-card[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank"] and ._40jaHq_he-item:nth-child(5) > ._40jaHq_he-card[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /webfullstack, /carrera-data-science, for example .TdP_qW_legalLink. Impact: serious.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 310 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
